product.label: Autocallable
product.script:
underlying SPX
param N = 100
param cpn = 0.006938757324728518
param coupon_barrier = 0.7
param trigger = 1
param put_strike = 1
param ki_barrier = 0.6

event 2021-06-30
  S0 = SPX
  missed = 0
end

event 2021-09-30 pay 2021-10-07
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2021-12-30 pay 2022-01-06
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2022-03-30 pay 2022-04-06
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2022-06-30 pay 2022-07-07
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2022-09-30 pay 2022-10-07
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2022-12-30 pay 2023-01-06
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2023-03-30 pay 2023-04-06
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  if perf >= trigger then
    pay N as redemption
    terminate
  end
end

event 2023-06-30 pay 2023-07-07
  perf = SPX / S0
  if perf >= coupon_barrier then
    pay N * cpn * (1 + missed) as coupon
    missed = 0
  else
    missed = missed + 1
  end
  knocked_in = perf < ki_barrier
  if knocked_in then
    pay N - N * max(put_strike - perf, 0) as redemption
  else
    pay N as redemption
  end
end
